title: Golden Scene Manifest
description: Machine-readable contract for reproducible visual benchmarks of the RC Simulation Engine renderer. v1 supports only runtime-configurable parameters verified against crates/app/src/render_app.rs. Future capabilities are documented separately in docs/architecture/rv2_vis0_visual_benchmark.md.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema (e.g., '1.0.0'). Used for forward compatibility.

scene_id.description: Unique identifier for this scene. Format: <category>_<scenario>_<variant>. Example: 'aircraft_acro_static_front'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this scene tests or demonstrates.

version.description: Renderer backend version. 'v1' = legacy, 'v2' = physical atmosphere/IBL. Maps to --renderer CLI flag.

terrain_debug.description: Terrain debug visualization mode. Maps to --terrain-debug CLI flag. Values verified from TerrainDebugMode::from_label in crates/renderer/src/gpu.rs.

vegetation_debug.description: Vegetation debug visualization mode. Maps to --vegetation-debug CLI flag. Values verified from VegetationDebugMode::from_label in crates/renderer/src/vegetation.rs.

preset.description: Scenery preset. Maps to --scenery CLI flag. 'none' = empty, 'flying-field' = RC airfield with runway, markings, fence, windsock. Values verified from SceneryPreset enum in crates/renderer/src/scenery.rs.

scenery.description: Scenery environment configuration. Only runtime-configurable parameters.

mode.description: Camera mode. Maps to --camera CLI flag.

vertical_fov_deg.description: Vertical field of view in degrees. Maps to --camera-fov CLI flag. Typical: 55-70.

pilot_position_render_m.description: Pilot camera position in render-body frame [x, y, z] in meters. Required when mode='pilot'. Maps to --pilot-position CLI flag (format: x,y,z).

chase_distance_behind_m.description: Chase camera distance behind aircraft in meters. Required when mode='chase'. Maps to --chase-distance-m CLI flag.

chase_height_above_m.description: Chase camera height above aircraft in meters. Required when mode='chase'. Maps to --chase-height-m CLI flag.

camera.description: Camera configuration. Mode-specific parameters are required based on the mode value, and fields from the wrong mode are rejected.

exposure_ev.description: Manual exposure value in EV stops. Maps to --exposure-ev CLI flag. 0 = neutral, +1 = 2x brighter, -1 = 2x darker. Runtime range [-8, 8] verified from validate_exposure_ev in crates/renderer/src/gpu.rs.

model.description: Path to aircraft model.json relative to repo root. Maps to --model CLI flag. Example: 'models/acro_electric_01/model.json'.

throttle.description: Engine throttle setting 0.0-1.0. Maps to --throttle CLI flag.

start_on_ground.description: Whether aircraft starts on ground. Maps to --start-on-ground CLI flag.

warmup.description: Number of frames to render before capture. Allows renderer to stabilize.

filename.description: Output filename. Must match format extension. Stable golden baseline format: <scene_id>_<width>x<height>.png (no timestamp). Example: 'aircraft_acro_static_front_1920x1080.png'.

format.description: Image format. PNG = lossless, JPG = lossy, EXR = HDR.

frame.description: Specific frame number to capture. If omitted, captures frame after warmup.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100. Only allowed when format='jpg'. Must be absent for png/exr.

tags.description: Tags for categorization and filtering. Example: ['aircraft', 'acro', 'static', 'front-view'].

notes.description: Additional notes about reference hardware setup.

reference_hardware.description: Reference hardware for which this baseline was validated. Optional. Should only be populated when a real approved baseline exists on that hardware.
